mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_knowledge_mastery (user_id, knowledge_block_id, subject_code, total_attempts, correct_attempts, accuracy_rate, mastery_level, weakness_score, last_practiced_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{knowledgeBlockId}, #{subjectCode}, #{totalAttempts}, #{correctAttempts}, #{accuracyRate}, #{masteryLevel}, #{weaknessScore}, #{lastPracticedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_attempts = VALUES(total_attempts), correct_attempts = VALUES(correct_attempts), accuracy_rate = VALUES(accuracy_rate), mastery_level = VALUES(mastery_level), weakness_score = VALUES(weakness_score), last_practiced_at = VALUES(last_practiced_at)
